morphological_context.steffel_merrill: Historical relevant -ameke chains can be analyzed with participial -(a)me followed by optional reduplicative -kV/-ke.
morphological_context.caballero_choguita: Modern -ame and -kame belong to the participial domain; in adjectival/relative uses they are treated as suppletive allomorphs. Caballero also reports a diachronic Guarijío analysis of -kame as -ka/-ga + -ame.
morphological_context.estrada_grageda: The published color comparison states that Steffel's derived color endings have related forms persisting in Hilton and Brambila and discusses Hilton -nami/-cami variation.
morphological_context.interpretive_rule: Treat the shared participial/derivational domain as the robust comparison target; do not collapse -ameke, -cami/-nami and -kame into a single unanalyzed suffix.

research_consequence: The color domain now supplies several externally published historical-modern correspondences that are independently reproduced in the pinned SRC-02 master. This materially strengthens the diachronic argument and creates a dedicated testbed for distinguishing root continuity from suffix allomorphy and additional morphology.
